item.title: [HIGH] Iran-nexus Dust Specter hits Iraqi officials with malware showing generative AI traces
item.description: Zscaler found a January 2026 campaign impersonating Iraq's foreign ministry that dropped TWINTASK, TWINTALK and GHOSTFORM; emojis and placeholders in decompiled code suggested generative AI helped build the malware. Target: Iraqi government officials. IQ. Verification: confirmed.
